flavor.description: Nova flavor name or ID for the machine.

network.description: Neutron network name or ID the machine port is created in.

security_groups.description: Security group names or IDs for the machine port. Must allow egress to Omni (SideroLink).

volume_type.description: Optional Cinder volume type for the boot volume (requires compute API microversion 2.67+).

availability_zone.description: Nova availability zone: a concrete zone name, or "auto" to rotate across all zones read live from Nova (stateless round-robin per machine). Empty leaves the choice to Nova's default.

firmware.description: Machine firmware boot mode. Creates a separate Glance image per mode (firmware is a Glance image property in OpenStack). Empty leaves the Nova default.

server_group.description: Optional Nova server group (name or ID) whose policy spreads the machines, e.g. created with: openstack server group create --policy soft-anti-affinity <name>. Use one group per machine class (control planes separate from workers) so Nova places machines on different compute hosts.

metadata.description: Optional key/value metadata attached to the server (billing, ownership, ...).

additional_disks.description: Additional Cinder volumes attached to the machine (e.g. for Longhorn).

additional_nics.description: Additional network interfaces: each entry creates a Neutron port in the given network (name or ID) and attaches it to the machine. Ports are named <machine>-nic-<n> and cleaned up with the machine.
